title: Naija API Directory
about: A community list of APIs and developer services for building software in Nigeria. Inclusion is not an endorsement. Check each provider's current docs, pricing and terms.

categories.intro: Accept cards, bank transfers, USSD and wallets, and pay out to Nigerian bank accounts.

services.name: Paystack
services.what: Online checkout, payment links, subscriptions, transfers and split payments. Cards, bank transfer, USSD and QR.
services.note: Acquired by Stripe in 2020. Widely used by Nigerian startups and SMEs.

services.name: Flutterwave
services.what: Pan-African payments: cards, transfers, mobile money, USSD and payment links across many currencies. Also offers bills payment APIs.
services.note: Good fit if you plan to sell in several African countries.

services.name: Monnify (Moniepoint)
services.what: Collections through dedicated virtual accounts, payouts to any Nigerian bank, and a bills payment API.
services.note: Monnify says it was the first Nigerian gateway to offer virtual accounts.

services.name: Squad (GTCO)
services.what: Collections by card, bank transfer and more, from Guaranty Trust's payments arm.

services.name: Kora
services.what: Pay-ins and payouts, including card, bank transfer and wallets such as OPay and PalmPay.

services.name: Interswitch (Webpay / IPG)
services.what: Long-standing payment gateway and switch. Verve cards, Quickteller and more.
services.note: Some developers find the integration heavier than newer gateways.

services.name: Remita
services.what: Collections and payments, widely used for government and institutional payments.

services.name: Fincra
services.what: Pay-ins (gateway, payment links, virtual accounts) and payouts, including cross-border.

services.name: SeerBit
services.what: Payment gateway for cards, transfers and more.

services.name: eTranzact
services.what: Payment processing and switching, one of the older Nigerian players.

categories.intro: Check NIN (via NIMC), BVN (via NIBSS), documents, faces and businesses before you onboard someone.

services.name: Smile ID
services.what: Pan-African ID verification: NIN, BVN, phone and document checks, selfie matching and business checks.

services.name: Dojah
services.what: Identity verification, KYC widgets, fraud checks and lookups for African businesses.

services.name: Prembly (formerly IdentityPass)
services.what: Identity and business verification APIs for Nigeria and other markets.

services.name: Youverify
services.what: KYC, KYB and AML screening for banks and fintechs.

services.name: QoreID (VerifyMe)
services.what: Identity, address and business verification in Nigeria.

services.name: Didit
services.what: Global identity platform with Nigerian NIN and BVN checks and published per-check pricing.

categories.intro: Read account data with consent, open accounts for your users, issue virtual accounts and cards.

services.name: Mono
services.what: Open banking: connect bank accounts, read statements and balances, direct debit.

services.name: Okra
services.what: Open banking API.
services.note: Shut down in May 2025. Remove it from old integrations.

services.name: Anchor
services.what: Banking-as-a-service: accounts, transfers, virtual accounts, cards, bill payments and bulk payouts.
services.note: Publishes an MCP server so AI coding tools can read its API docs.

services.name: OnePipe
services.what: Embedded finance through partner banks: accounts, payments and lending products.

services.name: Maplerad
services.what: Accounts, cards and payments infrastructure for African businesses.

categories.intro: Send OTPs, alerts and messages. In Nigeria, a registered sender ID and a backup route matter.

services.name: Termii
services.what: SMS, OTP, voice, WhatsApp and email APIs built in Nigeria, with a DND route for transactional messages.

services.name: Africa's Talking
services.what: SMS, voice, USSD and airtime APIs across Africa.

services.name: Sendchamp
services.what: SMS, voice, WhatsApp and email APIs for African businesses.

services.name: Twilio
services.what: Global SMS, voice, WhatsApp and Verify APIs. Works for Nigeria, usually at higher local prices.

services.name: WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta)
services.what: Official WhatsApp API. Needs a verified Meta business; you pay Meta per message plus any provider fee.
services.note: Meta business verification asks for registration documents and a website that match.

categories.intro: Sell airtime, data, electricity tokens, cable TV and more inside your product.

services.name: VTpass
services.what: Airtime, data, cable TV, electricity, education and insurance payments, with a sandbox.

services.name: Baxi (Onafriq)
services.what: Bill payments through a large agent network and API. Onafriq lists 248 billers.

services.name: Flutterwave Bills
services.what: Airtime, data, cable, utilities and tax payments from your Flutterwave wallet. Nigerian billers only.

services.name: Monnify Bills Payment
services.what: Airtime, data, electricity tokens, cable TV and education payments. API only.

categories.intro: Quote, book and track deliveries inside Nigeria and abroad.

services.name: Shipbubble
services.what: Shipping aggregator: one API for many couriers (DHL, UPS, GIG, Topship and others), with rate comparison.

services.name: GIG Logistics
services.what: Courier with APIs for shipping inside Nigeria and internationally.
services.note: Contact them for API access details.

services.name: Kwik Delivery
services.what: Same-day last-mile delivery API, mainly Lagos and Abuja.

services.name: Sendbox
services.what: Local and international shipping and fulfilment.

services.name: Topship
services.what: International shipping from Nigeria.

categories.intro: Reference data you'll need on day one: banks, states, LGAs and holidays.

services.name: ng-banks (npm)
services.what: Zero-dependency package listing CBN-recognised Nigerian banks.

services.name: Nigerian Banks API
services.what: Static JSON of Nigerian banks with logos and USSD codes, served from GitHub Pages.

services.name: States and Cities API
services.what: Open-source API for states, cities and LGAs.

services.name: OpenNG
services.what: Nigerian public data as a REST API: holidays, states, LGAs, with fuel and food prices planned.

services.name: API Ninjas: Nigeria bank holidays
services.what: Nigerian bank holidays by year, useful for settlement and payroll dates.

before_you_launch.name: CAC business registration
before_you_launch.note: Most payment, KYC and WhatsApp providers ask for CAC documents before you go live.

before_you_launch.name: Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPC)
before_you_launch.note: Applies whenever you process personal data of people in Nigeria, including ID checks.

before_you_launch.name: CBN open banking framework
before_you_launch.note: Went live on 1 August 2025. Affects how account-data and payment-initiation APIs work.

before_you_launch.name: SMS sender ID registration
before_you_launch.note: Branded sender IDs need approval per network. Plan a fallback route.
